description: Publishes a board and returns a link that opens it in the user's browser. Call check_board first. A board with errors is not published: the problems come back instead. With narration_language, the :::say blocks are voiced, so that the presentation plays with a voice. Give the link to the user exactly as returned.

autoplay.description: true: the link opens the board straight in the presentation player, which plays it step by step (for a presentation, an explainer, a video lesson). Leave it out for a board to look at and work on.

narration_language.description: The language of the :::say blocks, to voice them with the site's voice of that language. Leave it out for a board without narration, or to leave the voicing to the teacher.

narration_speed.description: How fast the voice speaks: 1 is normal, 0.85 or 0.75 slower (for younger students), 1.1 or 1.25 faster.

narration_voice.description: A voice id from get_voices for that language (a man's or a woman's voice, for example). Leave it out for the site's default voice of the language.

text.description: The whole board in the Math Board format: # title, :::companion, :::font and :::show lines under it, ## pages, Markdown with $...$ formulas and [words]{red highlight} spans, :::graph, :::geometry, :::solid blocks, and :::comment, :::say blocks and :::mood, :::show lines and marks (:::strike "+3", :::cancel, :::cross, :::underline, :::double, :::circle, :::box, and :::unmark to rub one out) under ### step headings. The ~~~mathboard fence around it is optional.

name: publish_board
title: Publish a board
